data.title: 角楯花凛 · 黄金赌船的桌球俯身瞄准
data.description: 极尽奢华的游轮贵宾VIP厅内，绿色丝绒斯诺克桌球台在水晶吊灯下流光溢彩。花凛换上了引人瞩目的黑色高叉漆皮兔女郎连体衣，俯身压低重心架杆击球。小麦色健康紧致的背部与臀腿曲线毕露，金眸凝视着白球，散发出兼具危险特工与致命尤物的双重魅力。
data.action: leaning low over green felt pool table, aiming cue stick, seductive athletic curve
data.lighting: warm glamorous chandelier highlights on glossy black leather and smooth tanned skin
data.mood: intoxicating seduction and cool undercover confidence
data.promptProse: Leaning over a green velvet pool table in a luxury VIP casino lounge, Kakudate Karin aims a billiards cue dressed in a sleek high-leg black bunny suit, her golden eyes blazing.
